title: Harden combat runtime and model-tier evaluation after first combat playtest
description:
Follow-up from the first Claude combat playtest after `eshyra-l3b3`. Combat now executes far enough to reveal the next runtime layer: player-facing roll visibility, first-class monster combatant state, and expensive primary-DM retry churn from audit rejections. This epic should not reopen `l3b3`; it should build on it. It should also replace the informal Claude-vs-Codex comparison with a practical model-tier evaluation harness for primary DM and auditor roles.

Acceptance criteria:

- Child beads exist for player-visible roll display, encounter combatant state, primary-DM retry churn, deterministic combat regression, and model-tier evaluation.
- Beads distinguish runtime findings from model-style findings.
- Beads preserve the post-`l3b3` continuity/audit improvements.
- Model comparison work evaluates model tiers within each provider and role, not just Claude-vs-Codex.
close_reason: Completed post-combat-playtest hardening epic: roll visibility, combatant state, retry diagnostics, deterministic combat fixture, and model-tier evaluation all merged.
